verdict.rationale: Fathom offers its own non-interactive automation path: API-key-authenticated REST endpoints, official TypeScript and Python SDKs with built-in retry handling, and webhooks that can be created and deleted through API calls. A script or pipeline could run these without the UI. However, nothing documents a CLI, a CI integration, or headless control of the core recording workflow, so automation is limited to reading and exporting meeting data. Missing for 10: an official CLI or CI-runner guidance, headless triggering of meeting capture, and independent or hands-on corroboration of CI usage.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation

citations.quote: All REST API resources are authenticated with API keys generated via the Fathom website's settings area.
The official SDKs automatically retry rate-limited requests, waiting for the duration indicated by the `Retry-After` header.
You also have the option of creating and deleting webhooks with an API call.
The Fathom External API lets you poll meetings, teams, and team members
You can use this SDK in a Python shell with uv and the `uvx` command
